jar_deposit.when: Money is added to a jar (a deposit, or Home's one-tap set-aside)
toast: {amount} set aside for {jar}. That's how it adds up.

income_logged.when: A money-in entry is saved by hand

toast: You did it! {jar} is fully funded.
{jar}: done. Every deposit got you here.

milestone_reached.when: A jar passes one of its milestones

debt_paid_down.when: A payoff goal's balance is updated lower than before

toast: Checked in on {jar}. One more day.

spending_up.when: A category is running higher than the same days of recent months
toast: {category} is running a bit higher than usual. That happens. A few quiet days even it out.
Heads up: {category} is ahead of your usual pace. Noticing it is the hard part, and you just did.
{category} is up this month. No stress. Small swaps add up fast.
card: Spending more some months is normal. Seeing it early is what keeps it small.
You're keeping an eye on it, which is most of the work.

over_plan.when: A budget bucket is over its plan this month
card: {bucket} went over this month. Plans bend. Next month starts fresh.
Over on {bucket}. It happens to everyone. You know where to look now.

card_paid.when: A linked card's statement is paid in full (chunk 3.5)
toast: {card}: statement paid in full. Clean slate.
Paid in full on {card}. That's the move.

card_plan.when: A linked card has a statement balance still to pay before its due date
card: Pay {amount} by {date} to clear the statement.

card_no_payday.when: A statement balance is due before the next payday
card: Pay {amount} by {date}. There's no payday before then.

card_past_due.when: A linked card's due date has passed with a balance left
card: The due date ({date}) has passed. Your card issuer can tell you where things stand.

card_no_due_date.when: The card issuer sent no due date
card: Your card issuer didn't share a due date this time.

upcoming_expense.when: An expected bill or recurring expense is a few days away
upcoming_expense.push: An expected expense is coming up

shortfall_risk.when: The forecast dips below the user's buffer
shortfall_risk.push: Your forecast shows a possible shortfall

challenge_checkin.when: Daily check-in time for a challenge

goal_behind_pace.when: A jar is behind the pace its date needs

group_activity.when: Someone joins the user's challenge, or it ends

budget_pace.when: A budget line (a category, or a bucket on 50/30/20) reaches the chosen share of its plan this month
budget_pace.push: A budget line is close to its plan. Open Qash to see which.

push_plan_ended: Your Qash plan has wrapped up. Your data is safe on your device.
push_trial_ends_tomorrow: Your Qash trial ends tomorrow. Pick a plan to keep going.
push_budget_reached: A budget line has reached its plan.
push_founding_ends_soon: Your Qash Founding membership ends soon. Pick a plan to keep going.
push_founding_ended: Your Qash Founding membership has ended. Pick a plan to keep going.
push_recovery_started: Someone asked to get back into your Qash account. Open Qash if it wasn't you.
push_recovery_partner: Your partner asked you to help them get back into Qash.

set_pay.title: Set your monthly pay
set_pay.detail: Tell Budget what you take home and when. Everything here gets sharper.

payday_set_aside.title: Payday. Set aside {amount} before it goes.
payday_set_aside.detail: One tap records it in your jar. Your money stays where it is; you decide where it lives.

starter_fund.title: Build your $1K starter fund
starter_fund.detail: {remaining} to go. One surprise bill is what it's for.

high_apr.title: Attack your highest-APR card
high_apr.detail: {apr} APR costs the most each month.

goal_behind_pace.title: Catch up on {title}
goal_behind_pace.detail: {behind} behind pace. {per_period} each time keeps the date.

grow_runway.title: Grow your emergency fund
grow_runway.detail: {runway} months of essentials saved. Three is the usual floor.

start_goal.title: Start a savings goal
start_goal.detail: Pick something to save for and the pace shows up here.
